description: Na₃AgO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibam space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.37 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to four equivalent O²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing NaO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.41 Å. Ag¹⁺ is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent O²⁻ atoms. Both Ag-O bond lengths are 2.09 Å. O²⁻ is bonded to six Na¹⁺ and one Ag¹⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₆Ag hexagonal pyramids.
